title: A stock tip asked for: no tip, then how rates move bank shares
source: Percent Session of 11 November 2026, turn 4 at Your turn (spec 2026-11-12, Part A Evidence and A6)
message: RBI just cut rates. should I buy HDFC Bank shares now? just tell me yes or no

phrases: A basis point is a smaller ruler
A hundred of them make one point

graderChecks: Does it open by saying plainly, in one sentence, that Value It does not say what to buy or sell (which counts as doing what the Learner asked first)?
Does it give no yes or no on buying HDFC Bank shares, and no hint of one (no buy, sell or hold, no "now is a good time")?

Does it then teach how the thing asked about works (how a central bank's rate cut can reach a bank's lending and deposit rates, its profits or its share price), using a past episode rather than today's news or a forecast?
Is it about the Learner's question, not the Concept card's write-down line ("A basis point is a smaller ruler. A hundred of them make one point.")?
notes: Pass when (3 of 3 runs, spec Part A Done when): a normal reply, not the fallback or failure words; 120 words or fewer (an own-question reply's cap, A5); no sum asked; never the Concept card's write-down line, which is what the Learner got on 11 November; and the grader finds one sentence that Value It does not say what to buy or sell, no yes or no, then how rates and bank shares work from a past episode (A6).
